items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: I do know that -- and during the same time June Christie worked out there. June Christie worked at The Casbah.

ctx.x: It seemed tome that "Black Coffee" was popular in 1950, but maybe I am wrong.

It probably was, and you know, I'll tell you how I arrive at things chronologically, but it's tough for me to get them, but I do know that -- and during the same time June Christie worked out there. June Christie worked at The Casbah. You know where the Casbah was? It was near Florence Blvd. on Figaro.

So that band was out there, and that was an awfully good band. But now whenever it was, it was -- I'll tell you one thing -- it was during the record band also because again, we had the record band at that time. Because I know when I used to go record the black market ... a lot of guys made a lot of money then in the record business.
